        theorem MagnitudeConjecture.DirectMeshHeight.height_arrow {V : Type u} (rank : V → ℕ) (E : V → V → Prop) (hE : ∀ (x y : V), E x y → rank x < rank y) (hmesh : ∀ (x : V), (∀ (a b : V), E a x → E b x → a = b) ∨ ∃ (t : V), ∀ (y : V), E y x → E t y) (x y : V) :
        E x y → height rank E hE y = height rank E hE x + 1

        A boundary vertex has at most one predecessor; at an interior vertex all predecessors receive an arrow from its translate. These local conditions force every arrow to increase height by exactly one.
